Name: Zadok, High Priest
Summary: Zadok the priest stayed loyal to David through Absalom's revolt and Adonijah's bid, anointed Solomon at Gihon, and was made priest in Abiathar's place.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Abiathar, Priest; Nathan
LifeLesson: Loyalty through a succession crisis is remembered: Zadok stayed when others hedged.
